templates.name: Search with Categories
templates.description: A search bar that includes a dropdown to filter searches by category
templates.html:
<style>
                          .sb2-wrap{padding:80px 20px;background:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;justify-content:center;}
                          .sb2-form{width:100%;max-width:700px;display:flex;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);}
                          .sb2-select{background:#f1f5f9;border:none;padding:15px 20px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#334155;outline:none;cursor:pointer;border-right:1px solid #cbd5e1;font-family:inherit;min-width:140px;}
                          .sb2-input{flex:1;border:none;padding:15px 20px;font-size:16px;color:#111;outline:none;font-family:inherit;}
                          .sb2-btn{padding:15px 25px;background:#10b981;color:#fff;border:none;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background 0.3s;font-family:inherit;}
                          .sb2-btn:hover{background:#059669;}
                          @media(max-width:600px){
                            .sb2-form{flex-direction:column;border-radius:12px;border:none;box-shadow:none;gap:10px;}
                            .sb2-select,.sb2-input,.sb2-btn{border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:8px;}
                            .sb2-select{border-right:1px solid #cbd5e1;}
                          }
                        </style>
                        <section class="sb2-wrap">
                          <form class="sb2-form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault();">
                            <select class="sb2-select">
                              <option value="all">All Categories</option>
                              <option value="design">Web Design</option>
                              <option value="dev">Development</option>
                              <option value="marketing">Marketing</option>
                            </select>
                            <input type="text" class="sb2-input" placeholder="Search keywords..." required>
                            <button type="submit" class="sb2-btn">Search</button>
                          </form>
                        </section>

templates.name: Minimal Underline Search
templates.description: A very lightweight search bar with only a bottom border
templates.html:
<style>
                          .sb5-wrap{padding:100px 20px;background:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;display:flex;justify-content:center;}
                          .sb5-form{width:100%;max-width:500px;display:flex;align-items:center;border-bottom:2px solid #e5e7eb;padding-bottom:10px;transition:border-color 0.3s;}
                          .sb5-form:focus-within{border-color:#111;}
                          .sb5-input{flex:1;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:24px;color:#111;outline:none;font-family:inherit;padding:0 10px;}
                          .sb5-input::placeholder{color:#cbd5e1;font-weight:300;}
                          .sb5-btn{background:transparent;border:none;font-size:24px;color:#111;cursor:pointer;padding:0 10px;transition:transform 0.3s;}
                          .sb5-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.1);}
                          @media(max-width:500px){
                            .sb5-input{font-size:18px;}
                            .sb5-btn{font-size:20px;}
                          }
                        </style>
                        <section class="sb5-wrap">
                          <form class="sb5-form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault();">
                            <input type="text" class="sb5-input" placeholder="Search..." required>
                            <button type="submit" class="sb5-btn">➔</button>
                          </form>
                        </section>
